description: Join a premier rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital full-time role offers a unique opportunity to shape staff competency and ensure the highest standards of patient safety and health within our compassionate environment.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, fostering continuous professional growth among our team. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, conducting surveillance, educating staff on best practices, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory guidelines to maintain a safe and healthy facility for residents and staff.We are offering a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. If you are a dedicated Registered Nurse passionate about education and infection control, we encourage you to apply and become a key part of our commitment to excellence.
requirements: Experience in staff development or education
Experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff education

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at a recently acquired facility, where your strategic vision and proactive approach will be crucial in shaping its future success and growth.As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to drive census and enhance community engagement. We are looking for a highly presentable and results-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is willing to work occasional weekends to meet business objectives. Your ability to build strong relationships and effectively communicate the facility's value will be key to this role.
requirements: Minimum of 3-5 years of marketing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or healthcare setting
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement effective marketing strategies
Professional and presentable demeanor with excellent communication skills
Willingness to work occasional weekends as needed
Proven track record of driving results and achieving census goals
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive and based on experience for the right candidate.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). This PRN opportunity allows you to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment. We are seeking a dedicated professional eager to contribute to our team's success.As a PRN Physical Therapist Assistant, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting patients with therapeutic exercises, functional training, and other rehabilitation activities. Your role will be crucial in implementing individualized treatment plans and documenting patient progress, ensuring high-quality care and positive outcomes.This role offers competitive hourly compensation ranging from $28.00 to $37.00, based on your experience. If you are a compassionate and skilled PTA looking for a flexible PRN position, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
